name: Craft
soft_passes: #3 abstract but coherent 4-quadrant/plus silhouette; nameable as a mark, not an object; quadrant identity leans on colour
#5 top-lit specular consistent across segments but unverifiable vs webp bloom at 102px source
#6 two full-saturation hues (magenta + electric blue) co-carry focus rather than one reserved accent
failures: #10 dark/tinted robustness: the two navy quadrants and the light plus-gutter are near-white-background-dependent; a dark render sinks the navy pair and inverts the gutter
light_model: top-down / environmental glass: specular sheen on the top edge of each segment, soft outer bloom on the magenta and blue quadrants, lighter bevel edge (#47598E) capping the navy pair, no long baked shadow
layer_stack: four saturated glass quarter-segments arranged around a plus-shaped negative-space gutter (magenta TL, blue TR, navy BL, navy BR)
specular highlight + bloom on the two bright top-row segments
devices: quartered pinwheel mark (four rounded quarter-petals around a plus-gutter of negative space)
two-bright / two-dark quadrant split (top row glows, bottom row grounds)
saturated glass segments floating on a frosted field rather than an opaque gradient squircle
abstract brand mark with no subject metaphor (recognition-led, Notion/Linear register)
rhymes_hint: abstract multi-colour geometric brand-marks on a light frosted field (petal/pinwheel logo-marks, glassy gradient identity tiles) — an abstract-mark/multicolour-glass family, distinct from object-glyph and monogram icons
notes: Source is a 102x102 web render (icon.webp), not a 1024 master — specular/bloom and true Liquid Glass layering are inferred, not confirmed; a Big Sur-era flat-vector-logo reading is possible. Mark sits with ~8% safe-zone margin, optically centred, whole frame is the light field. Icon does not communicate the app's subject (notes/docs) — pure identity mark. Icon vs cover: shared rounded-geometric/airy mood but loose palette coherence (icon's electric blue + magenta are far more saturated than the cover's pastel sky; magenta unechoed on cover). Era call is liquid-glass on the frosted-field + segment-specular tells, held softly pending a higher-res source.
